fact: API-Mali says its Guichet Unique is a centralised one-stop point that brings company registration, operating authorisations and Investment Code approvals together in one place.

Author Moctar Ousmane Sy writes that through API Mali's one-stop shop firms can pre-register online and upload scanned documents, but must still go to Bamako in person to file originals, pay and collect official documents.
Mali's Justice Minister announced that a digital management platform for the trade and personal-property credit register is nearing completion, with no commissioning date given.
